title: ZTAutoDrop

# ZTAutoDrop
![MC](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20-7BB241)
![MC](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1-7BB241)

**ZTAutoDrop** is a powerful and convenient client-side mod for Minecraft that allows you to automatically drop unwanted items from your inventory. Forget about clogging your inventory with cobblestone in mines or seeds on your farm!

## Key Features

* **Profile System:** Create and switch between an unlimited number of profiles (e.g., *"Mining"*, *"Raid"*, *"Farm"*).

* **Convenient Search:** Built-in item search by ID with visual display. Simply type the name and click to add to the "blocklist".

* **Speed Settings:** Delay slider (in ticks). Customize how fast items are dropped from the inventory.

* **Simple Controls:** Hotkeys for opening the menu and toggling the mode.

* **Localization:** Full support for **English** and **Russian** languages.

* **Full Control:** Works with both the main inventory and the hotbar.

## How to Use

### 1. Open Menu

Press **`L`** (default) to open the configuration GUI.

### 2. Create Profile

1. Enter a name in the left field (e.g., `Mining`).

2. Click **"Create"**.

3. Click on the profile name to select it.

### 3. Add Items

* **Method A:** Type the ID or part of the item name in the search bar (e.g., `stone`). Click on the item icon to add it to the drop list.

* **Method B:** Simply hold the item in your hand before opening the menu and add it.

### 4. Activation

Press **`O`** (default) to toggle auto-drop on or off.

> Chat message will appear: `[ZTAutoDrop] ENABLED (Profile: Mining)`

## Settings and Ticks

In the menu, you can adjust the **Delay**.

* **Low value (1-2 ticks):** Very fast dropping. Be careful on servers with anti-spam plugins.

* **Medium value (5-10 ticks):** Recommended for stable gameplay.
